decision: The platform owns exactly what the landing zone template declares — nothing more.
why: Without a declared boundary, application teams cannot act in their own subscription without checking with the platform first.

links.note: The ownership boundary relies on stack deletion to remove platform-declared resources when no longer defined in code.
Platform engineers are exempted from Deployment Stack deny assignments — they can modify platform-declared resources directly.

violations: Management lock applied to a platform-owned resource preventing Deployment Stack teardown.
